chunks: From him, from al-Hajjaj, from al-Hasan ibn al-Husayn al-Lu'lu'i, from Safwan, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'There was a blessing in Ali's (peace be upon him) fighting the people of the Qibla (those who rebelled while still Muslim). And if Ali (peace be upon him) had not fought them, no one after him would have known how to proceed with them.'

key_terms.أَهْلِ الْقِبْلَةِ: People of the Qibla; a term for Muslims who rebelled against their legitimate leader but remained Muslim.

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Imam Ali's battle against the Kharijites according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elucidates that Imam Ali’s (peace be upon him) campaign against the Kharijites, termed 'Ahl al-Qibla' for their retention of Islamic ritual despite rebellion, served as a crucial divine precedent. This engagement established the jurisprudential and practical methodology for subsequent leaders to manage internal dissent within the Muslim community, ensuring that the balance between unity and justice was preserved through armed action when necessary.
